# mxroute_forwarder (Data Source)

Look up one forwarder from a complete successful list; ambiguous matches fail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_forwarder" "sales" {
  domain = "example.com"
  alias  = "sales"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String)
- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain.

### Read-Only

- `canonical_alias` (String)
- `destinations` (Set of String)
- `email` (String)
